name: rust-phase4-quic-reuse-multiplexing
title: Rust Phase 4 QUIC reuse and multiplexing
description: QUIC-specific connection reuse for DoQ stream multiplexing and DoH3 H3 connection reuse; bounded lifecycle, backpressure, teardown, and resolver-key composition only.
